env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chains_closer_owner.lgo a/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chains_closer_owner.out
cp stdout ../native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
stdout '^ok call-shared-count$'
stdout '^ok local-reassign-owned$'
stdout '^ok flight-try-fail-owned-tail$'
stdout '^ok flight-panic-owned-tail$'
stdout '^ok local-copy-of-local$'
stdout '^ok value-drop-then-fail-owned-tail$'
stdout '^ok value-panic$'
stdout '^ok nested-chain-panic$'
stdout '^ok nested-mirror-chain-try-fail$'
cmp stdout ../../native.txt
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/chaincloserowner

go 1.27
